name: io.github.wgt19861219/godot-mcp-enhanced
description: Free open-source Godot MCP server — 36 tools, 3-layer architecture, security guards.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_PROJECT_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated allowlist of absolute Godot project paths the server may access (deny-by-default). Required for the server to operate on any project.

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path to the Godot 4.x binary. Falls back to PATH and project-level overrides (.godot/mcp-godot.json or project.godot [godot_mcp]) if unset.
